import json, sys, subprocess
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp/t')
import fuzz3, fuzz

def check(out):
    assert set(out.keys()) == {"version","results"}, out.keys()
    assert out["version"] == 1
    for r in out["results"]:
        assert set(r.keys()) == {"id","packets","connection","keys","received_total","streams","crypto"}, r.keys()
        for p in r["packets"]:
            assert set(p.keys()) == {"event","packet","status","reason","at_ms","frame"}, p.keys()
            assert p["status"] in ("dropped","duplicate","buffered","accepted","error")
            assert isinstance(p["frame"], (int, type(None)))
        c = r["connection"]
        assert set(c.keys()) == {"state","code","at_ms","source","peer_code","last_activity_ms"}, c.keys()
        assert c["state"] in ("open","closed","idle")
        if c["source"] is not None:
            assert set(c["source"].keys()) == {"event","packet","frame"}
        assert set(r["keys"].keys()) == {"I","H","Z","A"}
        for k in r["keys"].values(): assert k in ("absent","live","discarded")
        for s in r["streams"]:
            assert set(s.keys()) == {"id","highest","final_size","reset","stopped","delivered_hex"}
            assert isinstance(s["reset"], bool) and isinstance(s["stopped"], bool)
            assert s["delivered_hex"] == s["delivered_hex"].lower()
            int(s["delivered_hex"], 16)
        assert [s["id"] for s in r["streams"]] == sorted(s["id"] for s in r["streams"])
        assert [x["level"] for x in r["crypto"]] == ["I","H","A"]
        for x in r["crypto"]:
            assert set(x.keys()) == {"level","highest","contiguous_hex"}
            int(x["contiguous_hex"],16)
        assert isinstance(r["received_total"], int)

for seed in range(60):

    raw = json.dumps(doc).encode()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I","/app/submission/entry.py"],input=raw,capture_output=True)
    out = json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
    check(out)
    doc2 = fuzz.gen(seed)
